items.title: Claude Code v2.1.312 adds OIDC claims and safer large-file handling
facts: Added oidc.user_id_claim to the Claude apps gateway, to identify people by an id_token claim other than sub, such as Microsoft Entra ID's oid
Fixed Claude overwriting a very large CLAUDE.md, rules file or @-included file in a subdirectory after seeing only its start; Write now asks Claude to read it all or edit in place
Changed prompt and agent hooks to run at most 24 at a time per session, sub-agents included

items.title: Codex CLI 0.165.0 adds Vertex AI provider and GPT-6.1 Terra support
facts: Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with model_provider = "gcp"
Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs
Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it

items.title: SuperPlane 1.0 launches open-source AI software factory for engineering teams
facts: SuperPlane is an open source, model-agnostic software factory for engineering teams
It takes coding agents from ticket to verified, merged PR, with shared standards and full visibility
Last month, 52% of the pull requests our team merged were automated through SuperPlane

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.104 makes Assisted Permissions generally available
facts: Assisted Permissions are available without enabling experimental mode
Interactive and SDK Autopilot sessions keep waiting for attached background tasks instead of stopping after COPILOT_TASK_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
Managed model "fusion" now starts sessions on Auto and applies fusionTier settings

items.title: Gemini CLI v0.66.0 ships UI fixes and Gemini 4 optimization note
facts: fix(ui): implement synchronized output and isolate spinner rendering
fix(core): harden SKILL.md frontmatter parsing for single-line descriptions
Add Banner about Gemini CLI not being optimized for Gemini 4

items.title: Anthropic expands Claude access for US governments at 40% discount
facts: We're expanding our partnership with @USGSA
Under a new OneGov agreement, we are bringing Claude to federal, state, local, tribal, and territorial governments at 40% off

items.title: Google begins rolling out Gemini 4 Argon to Antigravity IDE users
facts: We are starting to slowly roll out Gemini 4 Argon to Antigravity IDE users
Be on the lookout for the update in the next 24hr

items.title: Claude Code prompt audits logs to find habits burning usage limits
facts: Claude Code can now audit its own logs and find the 3 habits burning your usage limit, for about 0.2% of our week
The usual version overcounted our usage 2.4x and missed a third of it. This one fixes both
